task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to With the left arm, position the tea-box with white TEA text left of the blue toycar with yellow roof accents
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂将带有白色 TEA 文字的茶盒放置在带有黄色车顶装饰的蓝色玩具车的左侧
